title: Fragile Glassware Shipments Arriving Shattered Due to Insufficient Fulfillment Packaging
summary: Multiple customers reported receiving 12-pack shipments of wine glasses with every glass completely shattered upon delivery. Reports indicate a systematic failure in fulfillment packaging, specifically a lack of internal protective cushioning, bubble wrap, and structural cell dividers to keep fragile glass items separated and padded during transit.
recommended_fix: Mandate updated fulfillment packaging protocols for fragile glassware, requiring structural cell dividers, heavy-duty bubble wrapping, and outer 'Fragile / Handle With Care' labeling. Conduct quality assurance audits on fulfillment packing stations for multi-piece glass sets.
theme: Inadequate packaging protection/wrapping for fragile glass items during fulfillment or poor handling by the delivery carrier.
